files.content:
GitHub + Claude Code Setup Course

Progress

0% complete

Learning Paths

Modules

{
  "title": "GitHub + Claude Code Setup Course",
  "modules": [
    {
      "id": "m1",
      "title": "Module 1: Mac Developer Foundations",
      "path": ["beginner", "intermediate", "advanced"],
      "overview": "Install essential tooling and understand course flow.",
      "content": [
        "Install Xcode Command Line Tools.",
        "Install Homebrew.",
        "Verify terminal environment."
      ],
      "commands": [
        "xcode-select --install",
        "/bin/bash -c \"$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)\"",
        "brew --version"
      ],
      "checkpoints": [
        "Xcode tools installed",
        "Homebrew installed",
        "Terminal commands working"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "m2",
      "title": "Module 2: Git Setup",
      "path": ["beginner", "intermediate"],
      "overview": "Install and configure Git for daily development.",
      "content": [
        "Install Git with Homebrew.",
        "Set global user.name and user.email.",
        "Set default branch naming convention."
      ],
      "commands": [
        "brew install git",
        "git --version",
        "git config --global user.name \"Your Name\"",
        "git config --global user.email \"you@example.com\"",
        "git config --global init.defaultBranch main"
      ],
      "checkpoints": [
        "Git installed",
        "Identity configured",
        "Global config verified"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "m3",
      "title": "Module 3: GitHub Auth + SSH",
      "path": ["beginner", "intermediate", "advanced"],
      "overview": "Create secure GitHub authentication with SSH keys.",
      "content": [
        "Generate SSH keypair.",
        "Add key to ssh-agent.",
        "Add public key to GitHub settings.",
        "Test connectivity."
      ],
      "commands": [
        "ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"you@example.com\"",
        "eval \"$(ssh-agent -s)\"",
        "ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519",
        "cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub",
        "ssh -T git@github.com"
      ],
      "checkpoints": [
        "SSH key created",
        "Public key added to GitHub",
        "SSH auth test successful"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "m4",
      "title": "Module 4: GitHub CLI + Repo Workflow",
      "path": ["intermediate", "advanced"],
      "overview": "Use GitHub CLI and Git branching workflow.",
      "content": [
        "Install GitHub CLI.",
        "Authenticate via browser.",
        "Clone repo and push branch workflow."
      ],
      "commands": [
        "brew install gh",
        "gh auth login",
        "git clone git@github.com:OWNER/REPO.git",
        "git checkout -b feature/my-change",
        "git add . && git commit -m \"My change\" && git push -u origin feature/my-change"
      ],
      "checkpoints": [
        "gh installed and authenticated",
        "Repository cloned",
        "Branch pushed successfully"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "m5",
      "title": "Module 5: Install + Use Claude Code",
      "path": ["beginner", "intermediate", "advanced"],
      "overview": "Install Claude Code and use it inside real project flow.",
      "content": [
        "Install Node.js.",
        "Install Claude Code CLI.",
        "Authenticate and run first prompts."
      ],
      "commands": [
        "brew install node",
        "npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code",
        "claude --version",
        "claude"
      ],
      "checkpoints": [
        "Node installed",
        "Claude CLI installed",
        "Claude authenticated"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "m6",
      "title": "Module 6: Practice + Checkpoints",
      "path": ["beginner", "intermediate", "advanced"],
      "overview": "Hands-on exercises to cement daily workflow.",
      "content": [
        "Create your first repository.",
        "Make a commit and push.",
        "Use Claude to explain/refactor code.",
        "Open a pull request."
      ],
      "commands": [
        "git init",
        "git add .",
        "git commit -m \"Initial commit\"",
        "git push -u origin main",
        "gh pr create --fill"
      ],
      "checkpoints": [
        "Repo created and pushed",
        "Claude assisted a coding task",
        "Pull request opened"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
